Name: MULTI_ESTUS_FLASK_BONUS_PARAM_ST
Description: Flask charges given to a player when an Elden Ring-style multiplayer event completes (area boss cleared or a phantom's session ending in success); the row and column are picked by the player's join type. NR still has the reader, reached only from multiplayer events kept from Elden Ring, and whether an NR session ever triggers them is not established. Retail: the 5 base-game Elden Ring rows, unchanged.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Host
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is the host (or has no join type).

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - White Phantom - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - White Phantom - Gold
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - White Phantom - Berserker
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a Berserker join type cooperator summoned by a summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - None
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is an invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Gold
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Berserker
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a Berserker join type invader summoned by a red summon sign.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - None - Invasion
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is an invader who invaded.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Gold - Invasion
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a gold (Umbasa join type) invader who invaded.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Black Phantom - Berserker - Invasion
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a Berserker join type invader who invaded.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Red Hunter [1]
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a hunter (first hunter join type) summoned to hunt invaders.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Red Hunter [2]
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a hunter (second hunter join type) summoned to hunt invaders.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Forest Guardian
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a Forest guardian (area guardian join type).

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Anor Guardian
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is an Anor guardian (area guardian join type).

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Arena
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is an arena opponent.

Fields.Name: Flask Recovery - Yellow Monk
Fields.Description: Flask charges restored when the defeated player is a Yellow Monk phantom.
